model.name: TTS MiniMax H3 Voice Clone 20B
model.description: Experimental 32 kHz stereo dialogue generation with one segment per speaker turn, one or two cloned voices, and Whisper boundary cleanup. Reuses the pruned H3 Ref2VA checkpoint, jointly denoises a hidden 32x32 video, and saves only audio.

prompt:
Speaker 1:
[English, thoughtful and close to the microphone] I thought the hardest part would be finding the right words.

Speaker 2:
[English, warm and reassuring] Sometimes the right voice is what helps the words arrive.
